description:
Save the active pixel selection to a new alpha channel.

Use when: preserving a selection for later reload or batch workflows.
Do NOT use when: no selection exists — create one first.

Returns: JSON { ok, summary, details: { channel_name, context } }.
Preconditions: active document and active pixel selection. Side effects: adds alpha channel.

channel_name.description: Optional name for the new alpha channel (auto-generated if omitted)

document_id.description: Photoshop document id from photoshop_get_state / photoshop_list_documents. Send null to use the active document. A number activates that document before the tool runs.

name: photoshop_save_selection
